description: Fix the two largest root-cause clusters: (A) change moduleResolution from 'node' to 'bundler' in apps/backend/tsconfig.app.json, which cascades to fix @ovds/core/vat, @orpc/server, @ovds/contracts, ae-vat/et-vat rule engine errors; and (B) fix the wrong relative path in packages/shared/database/src/prisma.service.ts and src/index.ts (4 ups → 3 ups), which fixes all '@prisma/client has no exported member PrismaClient' errors across shared/database, and cascades to fix declaration/integration PrismaService missing property errors. Also add 'jsx': 'react-jsx' to apps/backend/tsconfig.app.json to fix TS6142 JSX-not-set errors from features/accounting being compiled as a dependency.
steps: 1. Edit apps/backend/tsconfig.app.json: change '"moduleResolution": "node"' to '"moduleResolution": "bundler"'. Also add '"jsx": "react-jsx"' to compilerOptions. Do NOT change any paths entries — they are already correct.

2. Edit packages/shared/database/src/prisma.service.ts line 15: change import path from '../../../../database/prisma/generated/client' to '../../../database/prisma/generated/client' (3 ups from packages/shared/database/src/ reaches packages/).

3. Edit packages/shared/database/src/index.ts line 11: change import path from '../../../../database/prisma/generated/client' to '../../../database/prisma/generated/client' (same fix as step 2). NOTE: the lib/** files in packages/shared/database/src/lib/extensions/, lib/retention/, lib/sharding/, lib/seed/ already use the CORRECT 5-up path '../../../../../database/...' from their deeper location — do NOT touch those files.

4. Also fix packages/shared/database/src/lib/extensions/prisma-tenant.middleware.ts: it imports 'Prisma' from '../../../../../database/prisma/generated/client' which is the correct path. The Prisma middleware function signature uses 'any' parameters. Add explicit parameter types: (params: any, next: (params: any) => Promise<any>) to satisfy noImplicitAny.

5. Fix packages/shared/database/src/lib/extensions/audit-chain.extension.ts and prisma-migration-safe.extension.ts: the $extends query callbacks '{ args, query }' have implicit any types. Add explicit types: '{ args, query }: { args: any; query: (args: any) => Promise<any> }'.

6. Fix packages/shared/database/src/lib/retention/ledger-archiver.service.ts line 27: the tx parameter in $transaction callback has implicit any. Add '(tx: any) =>' or import PrismaTxClient from '@ovds/database'.
7. After these changes, run the verification commands and record outcomes in 'findings'.
